committee: * Presentation of Resolution No. 150-38 (COR) - Senator Tina Rose Muña-Barnes
title: Buenas yan Håfa Adai! Please join me in presenting, Resolution No. 150-38 (COR) - Tina Rose Muña-Barnes – Relative to recognizing the observance of “International Women’s Day” on March 8, 2026; and commending the International Women’s Club of Guam for its contributions to the island community. Presentation will take place during an event hosted by the International Women’s Club of Guam on Wednesday, March 18, 2026, which begins at 6:30PM at Hilton. Si Yu’os Ma’åse’ 3/17/26 2:40 (FN)
